title: Frequently Asked Questions on Family Planning
why_included: Kenyan national answers to the questions people actually ask about contraception. The only source that is both local and written as plain answers.

title: National Family Planning Guidelines for Service Providers (6th Edition)
why_included: The authority on what Kenyan family planning practice is -- eligibility, provision, who may access what. Provider guidance, so it grounds referral rather than answering a girl directly.

title: Family Planning: A Global Handbook for Providers (2022 edition)
publisher: World Health Organization / Johns Hopkins CCP / USAID
why_included: The clinical authority on how each method works, effectiveness and side effects. Provider-facing, so it settles what is true without being the voice she reads.

title: Impact of contraceptive use on women's health and socioeconomic status
why_included: Connects contraception to staying in school, employment and earning power. The evidence behind the empowerment half of the use case.

title: State of World Population 2024: Interwoven Lives, Threads of Hope
why_included: Rights framing and the inequalities in who actually gets access. Supplies the language of choice and agency rather than clinical fact.

title: Common questions about HIV
why_included: Questions drawn from what young people actually asked on UNICEF digital platforms, reviewed with young people and UN technical staff.

title: Common questions about Staying Safe
why_included: Consent, pressure and recognising unsafe situations, in the register young people used to ask about them.

title: Common questions about Being a Young Parent
why_included: Links pregnancy and parenthood to school, work and money -- the consequence side of the use case, answered without judgement.
